title: Clinic AI Voice Agent for Scheduling, Intake & Specialist Routing
description:
This is an AI voice agent for a medical clinic that can schedule appointments, carry out patient intake, and route callers to the appropriate specialist. It takes on the routine phone work that would otherwise tie up front-desk staff, letting patients simply call in and speak naturally with the agent.

It combines a Python backend and PostgreSQL with a JavaScript/Node.js and TailwindCSS interface, and uses an OpenAI-based LLM for the conversation. VAPI and Twilio provide the real-time voice and telephony layer that powers the live phone calls.
liveUrlNote: Deployed privately for the client's clinic, so there is no public demo.
